title: Implement Reputation-Based Ambient Audio for AI Agents
description: To enhance player immersion in SynergyVerse, AI agents should audibly react to the player's presence based on their reputation. Currently, AI agents are silent. This task involves implementing a system where each AI agent continuously emits an ambient sound that changes based on whether their reputation with the player is friendly, wary, or hostile. This requires modifying the AI agent's data structure, implementing new logic in the AI processing loop, and integrating with the resource and audio systems over three distinct development sessions.

project_spec.name: SynergyVerse: A Social Sandbox Metaverse
project_spec.description:
SynergyVerse is a large-scale, physics-driven social sandbox that lets thousands of players co-create, trade, and inhabit persistent worlds. Every creature, prop, and mini-game is made from attachable components (movement, health, chat-bubble, trade, physics body, network sync, etc.), allowing players and designers to remix behavior on the fly without touching engine code. A strong emphasis is placed on social interaction: shared housing, community-run events, collaborative puzzle solving, and a reputation system that influences AI NPCs’ reactions.

Under the hood, the simulation runs a deterministic Game Loop paired with a lockstep networking layer so that physics, audio cues, and AI decisions stay in sync for all participants. A Level Editor ships in-game, giving groups the power to sculpt terrain, script quests via Command objects, and instantly publish spaces. Persistent progression, cloud saves, and an Object Pool-backed resource manager keep the experience smooth even when player-generated content explodes in scale.
